name: EPP Power Modes
description:
Four fixed CPU energy-performance-preference modes (Power Saver, Balanced-Saver, Balanced-Performance, Performance) with an optional lock against firmware/ACPI drift and a battery safety net. Bypasses power-profiles-daemon entirely via a root helper.

Setup:
bash $HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/eppmode@yurij.de/install.sh
